title: AUR Packages Compromised with Infostealer and Rootkit
summary: A serious supply chain attack compromised approximately 400 Arch Linux AUR packages with infostealer malware and rootkits, targeting the open-source package repository ecosystem.
problem_solved: This security incident highlights the vulnerability of community-maintained package repositories to supply chain attacks where malicious code is injected through compromised maintainer accounts.
why_valuable: This serves as a critical warning about the risks of trusting community packages without verification, demonstrating how supply chain attacks can silently infect thousands of users through trusted repositories.
